base_member_text: [L1-L2] (LOW/working-directory/error-handling) The batch file relies on being launched from its own `bin` directory and does not check doxygen’s exit status before opening the generated index, so a failed generation can be presented as if documentation were ready.
audit_member_text: [L1-L2] (MED/working-directory-contract) Relative configuration and output paths require the caller to be in this script's directory, but the script never establishes that working directory.
[L1-L2] (LOW/error-handling) The HTML page opens even when Doxygen fails, potentially displaying stale documentation as the result of the current run.
